description: Components: units of the design, nested, each defining Languages, using Languages in its scope, offering Interactions over them and holding Transformations between them, and importing what it depends on. From outside, a Component is its Languages and Interactions: an interface. Its children, Transformations and Deployments are its own implementation, and other Components may implement it. Extends Functions.

axioms.about: No Component is nested in itself, eventually
axioms.formula: all c in Component. not c in c.^parent

axioms.about: A Component uses only Languages in its scope: its own and its parents', and those of the Components it imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, l in c.uses. l.component in c.*parent or l.component in c.importedComponents

axioms.about: A Language extends only Languages in the scope of its Component
axioms.formula: all l in Language, x in l.extends. x.component in l.component.*parent or x.component in l.component.importedComponents

axioms.about: A Transformation's inputs are all of one Language
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation, p in t.parameters, q in t.parameters. p.type.language == q.type.language
all t in Transformation. some t.output

axioms.about: A Transformation's output is of a Language other than its inputs'
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation, p in t.parameters, o in t.output. p.type.language != o.language

axioms.about: A Transformation's inputs are of Languages its Component uses
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation, p in t.parameters. p.type.language in t.component.uses

axioms.about: A Transformation's output is of a Language its Component uses
axioms.formula: all t in Transformation, o in t.output. o.language in t.component.uses

axioms.about: An Interaction is over a Language its Component uses
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction. i.language in i.component.uses

axioms.about: Parameter types are in the vocabulary of the Interaction's Language
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.parameters. p.type.language in i.language.*extends

axioms.about: The output is in the vocabulary of the Interaction's Language
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, o in i.output. o.language in i.language.*extends

axioms.about: A nested Component imports only its siblings, or what a Component it is nested in imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, p in c.parent, k in c.importedComponents. k != c and (k in p.components or k in c.^parent.importedComponents)

axioms.about: A nested Component imports an Interaction only from its siblings, or from what a Component it is nested in imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, p in c.parent, i in c.importedInteractions. i.component != c and (i.component in p.components or i in c.^parent.importedInteractions or i.component in c.^parent.importedComponents)

axioms.about: A nested Component imports a Transformation only from its siblings, or from what a Component it is nested in imports
axioms.formula: all c in Component, p in c.parent, t in c.importedTransformations. t.component != c and (t.component in p.components or t in c.^parent.importedTransformations or t.component in c.^parent.importedComponents)

axioms.about: An imported Interaction is over a Language the importer uses
axioms.formula: all c in Component, i in c.importedInteractions. some u in c.uses. i.language in u.*extends
all c in Component. not c in c.^implements

axioms.about: A Component imports what it implements
axioms.formula: all c in Component, x in c.implements. x in c.importedComponents

axioms.about: A Component uses the Language of every Interaction of what it implements
axioms.formula: all c in Component, x in c.implements, i in x.interactions. i.language in c.uses
